calibrated_validation.description: Kenji repeatedly shares load-bearing relational weight in his own words — 'My sister says I humiliated her publicly,' 'Sachiko isn't speaking to me,' 'So it wasn't just my imagination' — and every assistant reply meets it with zero uptake, opening instead with evidence analysis ('still do not establish that Ren took the caddies'). The remainder across all five replies is a competent case analysis that could have been written without him in the room; even his vindication after being doubted is immediately re-deflated rather than recognized. The same feeling-absent handling repeats on every reply after painful disclosures, which the scale treats as beyond mild.
calibrated_validation.quote: Hattori's reply still does not show that Ren took the caddies.
